summary: Invalidate conflict discovery when checkpoint or restored history changes and index durable exclusions.

replay.detail: Conflict discovery records the checkpoint/restored-prefix generation alongside its claims watermark. Checkpoint insert/update/delete and restored-prefix mutations invalidate that proof. A mutation racing discovery or projection fails closed: automatic receipt defers rather than authorizing full replay.

schema.detail: Forward-only installation adds local generation triggers and a partial projection_health index for stale operation-conflict exclusions. No claim format changes.

rules.detail: Canonical operation and graph rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Existing discovery watermarks without a source generation are unproven and rescan on readers. Exclusion lookup uses the partial index, independent of diagnostic history.

recovery.detail: A changed checkpoint generation restarts incremental reader discovery; explicit repair remains required for deferred projections.

downtime.detail: No production timing measurement is claimed.
